_help: moods: mood -> track files; categories: plan category -> mood (empty = every track fits every video, rotated so the same track never plays twice in a row). urls: track file -> where audio.py downloads it; sfx_urls: the same for the sound effects of assets/sfx (these mp3 files stay out of this public repo: the Pixabay license forbids passing a file on as it is). credits: track file -> line added to the post caption (CC BY tracks only, they may stay in the repo; Pixabay tracks need none).
